description: An addon that makes many BTW sound effects individually customizable by resource packs.

mods.name: Sound Tweaker
mods.description: This makes sounds of mechanical machines individually customizable.

releases.notes:
Updated to the full 3.0 release of Better Than Wolves CE.
Increased normal sound channels to 4096, and streaming sound channels to 128.

Sound definitions:
```
assets/btw/sound/
├─block
│ ├─beacon
│ │ │   activate.ogg
│ │ │   deactivate.ogg
│ │ │
│ │ └─anchor
│ │   ambient(1-7).ogg
│ │   respawn.ogg
│ │   scream(1-5).ogg
│ │
│ ├─bellows
│ │   blow.ogg
│ │   suck.ogg
│ │
│ ├─cake
│ │   scream(1-5).ogg
│ │
│ ├─enchantment_table
│ │     enchant(1-3).ogg
│ │
│ ├─mechanical
│ │   ambient.ogg
│ │   break.ogg
│ │
│ ├─mill_stone
│ │   active.ogg
│ │   idle.ogg
│ │   invalid.ogg
│ │   netherrack(1-5).ogg
│ │   wolf_cube(1-3).ogg
│ │
│ └─saw
│     cut.ogg
│     powered.ogg
│     unpowered.ogg
│
└─entity
  └─wind_mill
        overpowering.ogg
```
